[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximum subarray sum with one deletion** [LC 1186 · Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximum-subarray-sum-with-one-deletion/){difficulty="Medium"}

Two phases for a subarray ending at $i$: **no deletion yet**, or **one deletion already made**. Deleting $a_i$ itself moves from "no deletion, ending at $i-1$" to "deletion done, ending at $i$".
